items.description: vmware-go-kcl is a vmware originated open-source project for AWS Kinesis Client Library in Go. It has been widely used by many external companies and internally by Carbon Black. vmware-go-kcl-v2 is its companion project by utilizing AWS Go SDK V2 which introduces lots of breaking changes. To keep the repo clean, it is better to have a separated repo vmware-go-kcl-v2 with better golang project structure improvement.
